description: E1 (decision E1-2): a fetter-winch's barbed harpoon. The Skarn draw the great bow for 2.2 s behind an aim line that follows the giant for the first 70 % of the draw and then freezes on his legs; the harpoon flies straight at 70 m/s to that point, so a step aside after the freeze dodges it. Where it strikes it bites and its chain holds him (fetter winch: PlayerFetter - one chain slows him, two bind his legs, three pin him). It strikes as a 10 m attacker (the Skarn giants' engine): its damage is the bite, not the point (size_policy none).
